data.action: 斜倚在舒适布艺沙发上，单手递出一根巧克力棒，神情慵懒温柔
data.description: 【德克萨斯 · 罗德岛休息室的巧克力棒】罗德岛阳光明媚的舰内休闲室内，绿植盆栽郁郁葱葱。德克萨斯倚靠在柔软的深灰沙发上，放松地蜷起一条修长的腿。她从红色纸盒里抽出一根巧克力棒递向坐在对面的博士，眼神平静而温和——「给。吃点甜的，能清醒一些。今天还有两份加急运单需要你签字。」
data.lighting: 大型舷窗洒入的明媚柔和自然光与绿植阴影
data.location: 罗德岛舰船休闲休息室
data.promptProse: Inside a tranquil sunlit lounge aboard the landship Rhodes Island, Texas lounges comfortably on a soft grey fabric sofa beside lush indoor ferns. She wears her casual courier uniform with the sleeves rolled up, extending a chocolate pocky stick from a red cardboard box toward the viewer with a subtle, gentle gaze. Warm afternoon sunlight pours through the reinforced observation window, illuminating the soft sheen of her dark hair, wolf ears, and resting wolf tail. An intimate eye-level medium shot captures her rare relaxed warmth and understated beauty with clean anime visual novel elegance.
data.title: 德克萨斯 · 罗德岛休息室的巧克力棒
